Where more than one eligible candidate exists within the same priority category

Fill in all required personal, educational, and category details accurately.
Upload the required documents and certificates as prescribed on the portal.
Submit the application within the given time window, on or before 20 August 2026, midnight.
important_instructions: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Karyakatri posts. Selection under this notification is subject to the decision passed by the Hon'ble High Court in Writ Petition No. 13225/2012. If any discrepancy, incorrect fact, or figure is found in the application, or if the candidate's name or educational records do not match official records, or if any document is found to be false or fabricated, the candidature will be rejected. The applicant must be a resident of the same Ward/Gram Sabha as the vacant post; residency in the same Nyaya Panchayat is mandatory if no eligible candidate is available in the same Gram Sabha. Income certificates must comply with the relevant Uttar Pradesh Government Revenue Department order (No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj0-9 dated 30.09.2011, as amended) and must be online-verifiable. The BPL income limit for rural and urban areas will follow the order issued by the Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2, UP Government (No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2025 dated 14 September 2015, as amended). Only online, digitally signed residence and caste certificates issued by the Tehsil will be considered valid. For further information, candidates may contact the concerned Bal Vikas Pariyojna office or the Vikas Bhavan, or the Office of the District Programme Officer (Bal Vikas Vibhag), Sant Kabir Nagar, during office hours.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar Important Dates
Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies are distributed across 10 Bal Vikas Pariyojnas (rural/urban) in Sant Kabir Nagar district, with reservation for Scheduled Tribe (ST), Scheduled Caste (SC), Other Backward Class (OBC), and Unreserved (UR) categories. The Gram Sabha/Ward/Pariyojna-wise complete details of vacant posts, along with eligibility and reservation, are displayed on the notice boards of the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, Development Block, and Bal Vikas Pariyojna offices, and are also available on http://upanganwadibharti.in. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on the department's current status.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for Anganwadi Karyakatri posts. The applicant must be a resident of the Ward/Gram Sabha where the vacant post is located; if no eligible candidate is found there, selection will be made from the neighbouring Gram Panchayat within the same Nyaya Panchayat. Reservation provisions for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes will follow the relevant government orders applicable to Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for Anganwadi Karyakatri is Intermediate (Class 12) or its equivalent. The maximum qualification considered for merit preparation is Postgraduate. Merit lists will be prepared based on educational qualification, from Intermediate up to Postgraduate level, where more than one eligible candidate is available in the same category. Candidates who have completed their Intermediate or graduate-level education can also explore more 12th Pass Government Jobs and Anganwadi Recruitment Jobs available across India.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be determined based on the date of birth recorded in the High School mark sheet and certificate. As on 1 July 2026, the applicant's age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Salary
content_sections.text: Anganwadi Karyakatri posts are filled on an honorarium (मानदेय) basis, as per the recruitment notification. The exact honorarium amount is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Application Fee
content_sections.text: Not specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the post of Anganwadi Karyakatri is made on the basis of merit and a defined order of priority for candidates residing in the same Gram Sabha/Ward as the vacant post: Widow of a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family residing in the same Gram Sabha/Ward. Divorced or deserted woman of a BPL family, residing in the same Gram Sabha/Ward. Any other woman of a BPL family in the same Gram Sabha/Ward, if no widow/divorced/deserted candidate from a BPL family is available. If no eligible BPL-family candidate is found, the following priority order applies among Above Poverty Line (APL) family candidates in the same Gram Sabha/Ward: (a) Widow, (b) Divorced/deserted woman, (c) Any other woman of an APL family. If no eligible candidate is available in any of the above categories within the same Gram Sabha, selection will be made from the neighbouring Gram Panchayat within the same Nyaya Panchayat, following the same order of priority. Where more than one eligible candidate exists within the same priority category, selection will be made on the basis of educational merit (Intermediate to Postgraduate).

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Karyakatri Required Documents
content_sections.text: High School mark sheet and certificate (for age/date of birth proof) Intermediate and higher educational qualification mark sheets and certificates Death certificate and family register extract from the Gram Panchayat Adhikari/Nagar Nikay (for widow claim) Valid legal court order (for divorced/deserted status claim) Income certificate issued as per the prescribed government order, online verifiable, for BPL/APL family status Residence certificate and caste certificate — only online, digitally signed certificates issued by the Tehsil are valid

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: http://upanganwadibharti.in Locate the online application form for the applicable Anganwadi Karyakatri vacancy in Sant Kabir Nagar district. Fill in all required personal, educational, and category details accurately. Upload the required documents and certificates as prescribed on the portal. Submit the application within the given time window, on or before 20 August 2026, midnight.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar Apply Online
content_sections.text: Applications for Anganwadi Karyakatri posts must be submitted only online, through the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in, within the prescribed time. Offline or postal applications and documents will not be accepted or valid under any circumstances.

The applicant must be a resident of the same Ward/Gram Sabha as the vacant post; residency in the same Nyaya Panchayat is mandatory if no eligible candidate is available in the same Gram Sabha. Only online, digitally signed residence and caste certificates issued by the Tehsil will be considered valid. For further information, candidates may contact the concerned Bal Vikas Pariyojna office or the Vikas Bhavan, or the Office of the District Programme Officer (Bal Vikas Vibhag), Sant Kabir Nagar, during office hours.

faq.question: Q1. What is Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Sant Kabir Nagar, to fill 192 posts of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Anganwadi Worker) on an honorarium basis across 10 Bal Vikas Pariyojnas in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 192 posts are notified, though the department has stated this number may increase or decrease based on departmental status.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 20 August 2026, midnight.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for Anganwadi Karyakatri posts in Sant Kabir Nagar?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who are residents of the concerned Ward/Gram Sabha, meeting the qualification and age criteria, are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Anganwadi Karyakatri?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (Class 12) or equivalent; merit is prepared considering qualifications up to Postgraduate level.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applicant's age must be between 18 and 35 years, as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Anganwadi Bharti Sant Kabir Nagar 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through http://upanganwadibharti.in before the last date. Offline or postal applications are not accepted.

faq.answer: Selection follows a defined order of priority - starting with widows and divorced/deserted women from BPL families in the same Gram Sabha/Ward - followed by merit based on educational qualification where multiple eligible candidates exist in the same category.
